results.title: Quadrature rule optimization
results.summary: A compact five-node rule for estimating one-dimensional integrals, improved against a fixed public test suite. The report separates the acceptance score from direct residual errors so the gain can be inspected, replayed, and challenged.

website.card_summary: A five-node integration rule is compared against a fixed baseline, with both the acceptance score and direct residual errors exposed.

figure_captions.assets/objective-curve.svg: Best-so-far objective over the curated public trace. The acceptance score is lower-is-better and should be read as the contract used to retain candidates.
figure_captions.assets/candidate-trace.svg: Accepted quadrature rule: node positions, normalized weights, and residual error by representative integrand.

website.score_note: The objective is the evaluation contract used by the run, not a universal measure of integration quality. The scientific interpretation comes from reading it together with the residual errors and the replayable candidate.

results.title: PSPLIB J30 scheduling benchmark
results.summary: Across accepted checkpoints under one frozen PSPLIB J30 contract, Evölther reduced the lower-is-better scheduling score from 14.312 at baseline to 12.087, and Evölther 2.0 reduced it further to 10.108 while preserving feasibility on all 80 instances.

website.card_summary: A deterministic scheduling policy reaches a 29.37% lower governed score while preserving feasibility across the frozen portfolio.

figure_captions.assets/objective-curve.svg: Accepted-checkpoint progression from baseline through Evölther and Evölther 2.0 under one unchanged objective.
figure_captions.assets/benchmark-comparison.svg: Baseline, Evölther, and Evölther 2.0 comparison across the frozen portfolio.
figure_captions.assets/resource-load.svg: Actual renewable-resource profiles for baseline and Evölther 2.0 on j3025_9; capacities remain unchanged.
figure_captions.assets/instance-comparison.svg: Task-level baseline-to-Evölther 2.0 schedule comparison for j3025_9, from makespan 112 to 92 against optimum 84.
figure_captions.assets/portfolio-instance-deltas.svg: All 80 instance outcomes against baseline: 35 improved, 27 unchanged, and 18 worse.
figure_captions.assets/gap-readout.svg: Evölther 2.0 aggregate and tail diagnostics on the frozen portfolio.
figure_captions.assets/tail-gap-ladder.svg: Largest remaining Evölther 2.0 gaps against proven optimum.
figure_captions.assets/schedule-network.svg: RCPSP precedence and serial schedule-generation primer.
figure_captions.artifacts/schedule-example.json: Deterministic before-and-after schedule and renewable-resource profiles for j3025_9.

website.score_note: The score is the frozen evaluation contract for this public PSPLIB J30 subset. It is not a runtime benchmark and it is not a claim over all RCPSP instances.

results.title: 26-circle unit-square packing
results.summary: A deterministic 26-circle packing in the unit square reaches a validated total radius of 2.635983. The public result exposes the geometry, the validation contract, the original chain, and the seeded continuation that found the improvement.

website.card_summary: A 26-circle unit-square packing is validated as a deterministic geometry artifact, with the public chain and contact structure exposed.

figure_captions.assets/objective-curve.svg: Scored public candidates and best-so-far total radius.
figure_captions.assets/packing-layout.svg: Accepted 26-circle packing in the unit square.
figure_captions.assets/contact-readout.svg: Boundary and pairwise contact diagnostics for the accepted packing.

website.score_note: The evaluator score is negative total radius. The report also shows sum radii directly because that is the geometric objective readers inspect; the final improvement comes from a continuation seeded from the previous accepted geometry.

results.title: Qubit routing LightSABRE benchmark
results.summary: A deterministic qubit-routing policy is replayed against a frozen 24-circuit LightSABRE portfolio across Q20, Willow, and Heron-FEZ topology targets. The accepted candidate reduces aggregate added CNOTs by 12,294 while keeping the topology split and case-level readout public.

website.card_summary: A routing policy is replayed against LightSABRE on a frozen 72-case portfolio across Q20, Willow, and Heron-FEZ targets.

figure_captions.assets/objective-curve.svg: Objective trace for the curated public chain. Faint points are scored candidates, the solid line is retained best-so-far weighted CNOT reduction, and rings mark baseline and accepted.
figure_captions.assets/target-comparison.svg: Per-topology added-CNOT comparison for Q20, Willow, and Heron-FEZ. Shorter accepted bars mean fewer added CNOTs than the LightSABRE reference.
figure_captions.assets/routing-readout.svg: Selected largest case-level savings from the replay export, sorted by absolute CNOT reduction versus LightSABRE.

website.score_note: The governed score is the negative weighted CNOT reduction versus LightSABRE, so lower is better. The report also shows positive CNOT reductions because that is the more readable routing-quality readout.

results.title: Iberian BESS Policy Challenge
results.summary: A deterministic BESS dispatch policy is challenged against frozen Iberian day-ahead scenarios, commercial baselines, and a perfect-foresight upper bound with explicit risk and constraint readouts.

website.card_summary: A BESS dispatch policy is challenged offline against commercial baselines, oracle headroom, downside risk, degradation proxy, and hard constraint checks.
website.score_note: The score is a weighted euro-like benchmark objective over regret, baseline shortfall, degradation proxy, downside rate, and constraint penalties. Public sales claims should use it with the comparison and dispatch artifacts.

figure_captions.assets/objective-curve.svg: Seed, checked-in, and accepted policy scores under the v0.1 contract. Lower is better.
figure_captions.assets/baseline-comparison.svg: Accepted policy readout across uplift, regret, cycle-adjusted margin, downside, and constraint breaches.
figure_captions.assets/dispatch-readout.svg: Scenario-level dispatch trace: price, charge/discharge action, and state of charge.
